name: Winding Road
spec: yellow diamond with a black wavy arrow of three or more bends
meaning: A series of curves ahead; slow down.

snippets.back: Curve warning signs tell you of a sharp left turn, a curve to the right, a gradual curve right then left, or a winding road ahead.
Turn, curve and winding road signs warn drivers of bends in the roadway ahead.
Playgrounds, schools, children, narrow or winding roads and pedestrian hazards require lower speeds.
Slow when approaching or crossing intersections, rounding curves, nearing hilltops or using narrow winding roads, while accounting for people, traffic, weather, equipment and road hazards.
Reduce speed on narrow or winding roads and as you near a curve, the top of a hill or a railroad crossing.
Warnings can identify a sharp turn, a curve or a winding road ahead.
A Winding Road sign warns of a sequence of turns or curves ahead.
A Winding Road warning means several turns or curves lie ahead.
